title: Emoji Driven Crypto Assets Market Reactions

extraction.methodology_summary: The paper presents a multimodal framework that uses GPT-4 to generate descriptive text for emojis and combines it with tweet text. The combined text is embedded using a fine-tuned BERT model, and unsupervised sentiment scores are computed via cosine similarity between emoji vectors and a positive sentiment reference vector. These sentiment metrics are then correlated with next-day Bitcoin closing prices and weekly VCRIX volatility index changes, and used in algorithmic trading strategies based on moving average sentiment benchmarks.
extraction.universe: Kaggle Bitcoin tweets dataset filtered for tweets containing emojis, matched with Bitcoin closing prices and the VCRIX index

key_findings: Emoji sentiment derived from the multimodal GPT-4 and BERT architecture shows a significant positive correlation with subsequent day Bitcoin prices, whereas bottom sentiment levels show no significant relationship.
Emoji sentiment outperforms pure text sentiment analyzed by FinBERT in predicting next-day Bitcoin prices.
Higher daily sentiment scores are associated with both an upward direction and greater magnitude of changes in the VCRIX volatility index.

Trading strategies based on emoji sentiment moving averages achieve consistent profits, effectively avoiding major market downturns and generating higher returns compared to a standard buy-and-hold market trend.
limitations: The proposed trading strategies do not account for transaction costs.
